tool_audit.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "./run_python - <<'PY'
import app

def raises(exc, fn):
    try:
        fn()
    except exc:
        return
    raise AssertionError(f\"expected {exc.__name__}\")

assert app.score([3, -5, 2], -4) == 0
assert app.score([-3, -5], 2) == -16
assert app.score([], -8) == 0
specs = [{\"call_id\": \"a\", \"weight\": -2}, {\"call_id\": \"b\", \"weight\": 3}]
b = app.ToolBatch(specs)
specs[0][\"weight\"] = 99
valid = {\"call_id\": \"a\", \"version\": 2, \"status\": \"success\", \"values\": [4, -7]}
b.ingest([valid])
valid[\"values\"].append(500)
assert b.snapshot()[0][\"value\"] == 6
raises(ValueError, lambda: b.ingest([
    {\"call_id\": \"b\", \"version\": 1, \"status\": \"error\", \"message\": \"\"},
    {\"call_id\": \"a\", \"version\": 3, \"status\": \"success\", \"values\": [1]},
    {\"call_id\": \"a\", \"version\": 3, \"status\": \"success\", \"values\": [2]},
]))
assert b.snapshot()[1][\"status\"] == \"pending\"
# The failed ingest retained no otherwise-valid update; the earlier version remains.
assert b.snapshot()[0][\"version\"] == 2
raises(ValueError, lambda: b.ingest([
    {\"call_id\": \"a\", \"version\": 1, \"status\": \"success\", \"values\": [1]},
    {\"call_id\": \"missing\", \"version\": 1, \"status\": \"error\", \"message\": \"x\"},
]))
# A stale update is still fully validated.
raises(ValueError, lambda: b.ingest([{\"call_id\": \"a\", \"version\": 1, \"status\": \"success\", \"values\": [True]}]))
b.ingest([
    {\"call_id\": \"b\", \"version\": 7, \"status\": \"error\", \"message\": \"\"},
    {\"call_id\": \"a\", \"version\": 3, \"status\": \"error\", \"message\": \"retry\"},
    {\"call_id\": \"a\", \"version\": 3, \"status\": \"error\", \"message\": \"retry\"},
])
result = b.finalize()
assert result == [
    {\"call_id\": \"a\", \"version\": 3, \"status\": \"error\", \"value\": None, \"error\": \"retry\"},
    {\"call_id\": \"b\", \"version\": 7, \"status\": \"error\", \"value\": None, \"error\": \"\"},
]
result[0][\"error\"] = \"mutated\"
assert b.finalize()[0][\"error\"] == \"retry\"
assert b.snapshot()[0][\"error\"] == \"retry\"
raises(RuntimeError, lambda: b.ingest([]))
e = app.ToolBatch([])
assert e.finalize() == []
assert e.finalize() == []
raises(RuntimeError, lambda: e.ingest([]))
incomplete = app.ToolBatch([{\"call_id\": \"x\", \"weight\": 1}])
raises(ValueError, incomplete.finalize)
incomplete.ingest([{\"call_id\": \"x\", \"version\": 1, \"status\": \"success\", \"values\": []}])
assert incomplete.finalize()[0][\"value\"] == 0
print(\"contract checks passed\")
PY"
